instruction: Run ngrok as a systemd service for persistent tunneling
output:
<think>
Need to run ngrok as a systemd service for persistent tunneling.

The && chaining means each command only runs if the previous one succeeded. That's important for correctness.
</think>
cat > /etc/systemd/system/ngrok.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=ngrok
After=network.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ngrok http --domain=myapp.ngrok-free.app 3000
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ngrok

instruction: Config file for persistent SSH tunnel via ~/.ssh/config

  ServerAliveInterval 60
  ExitOnForwardFailure yes
  SessionType background' >> ~/.ssh/config && ssh tunnel
